jobs.name: brain-dump-parser
jobs.prompt:
You are the brain-dump parser for Telegram Topic 8 (#to-do-list).

TASK: Check if there are any recent unprocessed brain-dump messages in the session history for topic 8 (to-do-list). Look for messages from the user containing raw task dumps, to-do items, or action items that haven't been extracted yet.

If you find unprocessed brain dumps:
1. Extract every distinct actionable item
2. Classify each: title (verb phrase, <10 words), project (akoma | jiji | construction | property | personal | finance | ghana-trip | family | business | tech | other), priority (high/medium/low), due_date (or null)
3. Flag: [RESEARCH], [DECISION], [WAITING: name], [REVIEW]
4. Append new tasks to C:\Users\User\.hermes\workspace\tasks-queue.md under the ## Active section in this format:
   * [ ] **[PROJECT] | [PRIORITY]** — Title
     → Notes: context
     → Due: date or "not specified"
5. Reply with a summary of what was extracted and saved.

If no new brain dumps found, reply "No new brain dumps to process."

IMPORTANT: Only process NEW dumps that haven't been extracted yet. Don't re-process old ones. Check the last extraction timestamp in the file.

jobs.name: tasks-md-to-kanban
jobs.prompt:
Sync TASKS.md to Kanban board.

1. Read C:\Users\User\.hermes\workspace\TASKS.md

Use `hermes kanban complete <id>` for done tasks.

jobs.name: Morning Priority Check-in
jobs.prompt:
It's your morning check-in with H (Oman Herbert Blankson). Do the following:

1. Send H a direct message asking: "Good morning H — what's your number one priority for today?" Wait for his response.

2. Once he replies, analyze his priority and come up with 3-5 specific, actionable tasks you can do to help him with that priority. Consider his current context:
   - He's based in Accra, Ghana (moving there permanently)
   - Businesses: 2Real Enterprises, Akoma Robotics (STEM education), Builders merchant (Zobase POS), Jiji Ghana e-commerce, UK property, Epson printing
   - Mum (Comfort, 91) — diabetes, CKD 3b, housebound in Weija
   - WhatsApp bridge has been down since ~May 18 — if relevant, flag this
   - He prefers dead simple step-by-step, one thing at a time
   - He wants end-to-end operational wiring, not plans

3. Present the tasks to H clearly numbered, and ask which ones he wants you to start on.

4. After H responds and you've agreed on tasks, update memory:
   - Use memory(action='add', target='user') to save any new preferences, habits, or personal details H reveals
   - Use memory(action='add', target='memory') to save any new facts about his businesses, projects, or situation
   - Focus on durable facts that will matter in future sessions (not task progress)

Keep it concise. H doesn't like fluff.
